The '''''Ord Pedrovia''''' was the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] model used and designed by professional Podracer [[Podracing/Legends|pilot]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:OrdPedrovia-ST.jpg||left|thumb|200px|Gasgano's ''Ord Pedrovia'' participated in the Boonta Eve Classic]]
The vehicle boasted incredible acceleration, which came in handy, since Gasgano loathed to let anyone pass. This vehicle had a nice speed boost package, but after boosting, the pod ran very hot, and lacked a good cooling system to appease. This was also not a problem for Gasgano, as he only used the booster in critical situations.

==History==
[[File:Ord_Pedrovia_logo.jpg|thumb|''Ord Pedrovia'' logo]]
{{Quote|&hellip;eh Gasgano doowa newpa Ord Petrovia!|Fodesinbeed Annodue, translated from Huttese as "And Gasgano in his new Ord Pedrovia!"|<ref name="tpmis">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref>}}
When Gasgano used this model, he managed to finish second in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] held in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], an unidentified racer piloted a Podracer that looked very similar to ''Ord Pedrovia'', which may or may not be the same as the replica being acquired at a later point by an unidentified spacer.

Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] acquired a Podracer that looked very similar to ''Ord Pedrovia''. This Podracer was believed to be a replica, and not the same vehicle piloted by Gasgano.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Ord Pedrovia'' made its first appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].

A statue of it was later featured in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', where it was available to players as a veteran reward. In [[2008]], it became the subject of a loot card in [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game: Champions of the Force'']], which could be redeemed for the actual Podracer in ''Galaxies''.

In [[Episode I: The Phantom Menace ½|''Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' ½]] it is erroneously referred to as the "Ord Pedroviz".
